title: sync refresh exits 0 on successful refresh; --strict opts into status exit
description: sync refresh exits 1 when postRefreshStatusOk is false even though the refresh succeeded (commands.ts:8322), which broke && chains and trained agents to wrap every call in || true. Default exit reflects refresh success; --strict restores status-based exit.
acceptanceCriteria: sync refresh exits 0 when refreshOk=true regardless of post-refresh status; body still reports postRefreshStatusOk
sync refresh --strict preserves current exit semantics
closedReason: sync refresh strict/default exit semantics implemented and validated
